NAME: HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM
DESCRIPTION: If `HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM` is set to 1 it disables a memory optimization that sometimes causes problems on smaller VRAM GPUs.

NAME: HSA_ENABLE_SDMA
DESCRIPTION: If the underlying hardware has limitations regarding SDMA engines (DMA copy engines) and you suspect issues during large data transfers then you can try disabling SDMA in ROCm by setting `HSA_ENABLE_SDMA` to 0 before running the workload. This forces ROCm to use PCIe for transfers instead of the GPU's DMA engines. It might avoid certain hangs at the cost of performance.

NAME: AMDGCN_SCALARIZE_PACKED_FOPS
DESCRIPTION: Breakdown packed math ops such as `v_pk_mul` `v_pk_add` into un-packed version i.e. `v_mul` `v_add`. Packed math instructions cannot co-execute with mfma. It's better to increase the number of instructions that can overlap with mfma than having fewer instructions not hidden by mfma for a compute bound kernel.

NAME: AMDGCN_USE_BUFFER_ATOMICS
DESCRIPTION: Enable `buffer_atomics` instructions to atomically update data onto global memory.

NAME: AMDGCN_USE_BUFFER_OPS
DESCRIPTION: Enable `buffer_load`/`store` instructions to load/store data from/to global memory. `buffer_load`/`store` has the following benefits/limitations compared to global_load/store: (i) Fewer vgprs are required for addresses (ii) Offset must be within 32-bit (iii) No need for if-else branches to implement masked load/store.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_ASYNC_COPY_BYPASS_PERMUTE
DESCRIPTION: Optimizes the swizzling computations of direct-to-lds loads to avoid a ds_permute by doing pointer arithmetic which generally improves performance. It's safe for all workloads.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_ASYNC_FAST_SWIZZLE
DESCRIPTION: Changes the address calculations for direct-to-lds loads to help LLVM hoist more computations in front of the loop. It's safe for all workloads.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_GLOBAL_PREFETCH
DESCRIPTION: Sets the number of stages between load and local_store. This is used for simple experiment of the pipeline design. Users should **NOT** use it.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_LOCAL_PREFETCH
DESCRIPTION: Sets the number of stages between local_load and dot. Again users should **NOT** use it.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_USE_ASYNC_COPY
DESCRIPTION: Enable loading data from global memory into LDS a.k.a. Direct-to-LDS.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_USE_BLOCK_PINGPONG
DESCRIPTION: Enable pingpong scheduling for matmul kernels.|There is a WIP for a new IR design for Pingpong.

NAME: TRITON_HIP_USE_IN_THREAD_TRANSPOSE
DESCRIPTION: Transpose the loaded elements within thread before storing them to LDS. This guarantees largest vectorization when doing ds_read for mfma instructions with a price of potential sacrifice of ds_write vectorization.|This is a workaround solution on MI300 to deal with the case where loading a tensor that is not k-contig. NAME: TRITON_HIP_PRESHUFFLE_SCALES
DESCRIPTION: Apply preshuffling for mxfp4 scales for ROCm backend.
